0x1001B5D0.name: Fade_Update
0x1001B5D0.evidence: scales the frame scale by the rate at +0x18 and adds it to the value at +0x10 in states 1 and 3, counts the timers at +0x14 and +0xC down by the frame scale, sets the state at +8 to 2 when they expire, and clamps the value at +0x10 to the range 0 to 1
0x1001B5D0.summary: Advances a fade value by its rate each frame, moving between the fade states and clamping the value to 0 to 1.
